item.title: Show HN: Claude Code and Codex usage screen for TRMNL X e-ink
item.summary: "Memento costly" - while I pay just $200/month for Claude Code, it is easy to spend $2000 worth in tokens a week. Since I just got TRMLN X (I adore it, and I am not affiliated), I decided to show it - not only limits, but per day and per project record.
